facts.fact: Cabinet Secretary Kabogo said the National Cybersecurity Agency was established this year to lead national cybersecurity efforts and run the National Cybersecurity Operations Centre.
Communications Authority Director General David Mugonyi said the Authority issued more than 20 million cyber threat advisories through the National KE-CIRT/CC between July and September 2026.
The Communications Authority said it detected about 2.6 billion cyber threat events in July to September 2026, up 14.45 per cent on the previous quarter.
